findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_company, list_collections, express_interest · Private data: express_interest · Public sink: get_job, get_hiring_stats, join_network, express_interest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_job, get_company, list_collections, express_interest · Private data: express_interest · Public sink: get_job, get_hiring_stats, join_network, express_interest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
